# Chapter 1

Date: 2026-03-01

## Scenes

### 001.01 The Cold Forge

The party reached Emberfall and found the old forge dead. Brannoc Ironvein sat beside the cold hearth and would not meet their eyes, and the GM described soot on every beam.

#### Brannoc explains why the forge is cold.

- Brannoc says the forge went out the night his apprentice vanished.

### 001.02 The Envoy Arrives

Envoy Sella Marr of the Lantern Guild rode into the square and watched the party from her saddle.

#### Sella Marr takes the measure of the party.

- Sella Marr asks who speaks for the town.

## Memorable Moments

> "A forge is a promise, and mine is broken."
> — Brannoc Ironvein
> *Said to the cold hearth.*

## NPCs

### Brannoc Ironvein

A dwarf smith grieving the loss of his apprentice, who keeps his forge cold.

### Envoy Sella Marr

A courteous envoy of the Lantern Guild with a ledger always at hand.

## Locations

### Emberfall

A mining town in the foothills.
